blocks.content: The self-contained unattended build prompts that drove versions 0.2–0.4. Each is a complete mission brief: hard constraints (local-only, bounded storage, architecture invariants), the /tmp mirror build workaround, the resume protocol via STATUS.md, ordered features with acceptance criteria, and a definition of done. They are kept verbatim as the authoritative record of what was promised and shipped per version.
STATUS.md resume protocol, per-feature verification gates, smallest-version fallback, revert-and-defer rule.
The release checklist each version's final commit answers to.
